title: Derived pullback of the structure sheaf with local derived categories
statement: For any scheme morphism g:T→S [def-pc-scheme], and specified derived-category localizations [def-pc-derived-category] only for S and T, Lg* [def-pc-derived-pullback] of O_S in degree zero is isomorphic to O_T in degree zero. No flatness or Noetherian hypothesis on the morphism is required.

source.place: Tags 06YD and 06YJ; tensor unit identification in Modules, Tag 0096

proof.text: The single complex O_S[0] is bounded above by zero. Tensoring with its sole nonzero term is the identity, so it is flat; all other terms are zero and flat. Apply flatComplexDerivedPullback and the single-complex localization comparisons.

The object equalities specifying the termwise tensor-pullback functor, followed by tensorPullbackObjUnitToUnit_isIso, identify its value on O_S with O_T. Apply the degree-zero single functor to this isomorphism and compose.

theorem nonempty_derivedPullback_structureSheaf_iso
    {T S : Scheme.{u}} (g : T ⟶ S)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toRingedSpace))] :
    Nonempty ((derivedPullback g).obj
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
          (SheafOfModules.unit (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace))) ≅
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
          (SheafOfModules.unit (moduleRings T.toRingedSpace)))
